# Jumping and Dance: Open Source Training Practice Run

Date: 2026-10-29; upstream [Jumper](https://github.com/KingKongRobotics/jumper) submitted `b2e58669848a3ba4f209597cd6bebdfe9d0533a4`. Ubuntu workstation RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell, training environment `/data/Data14TB/envs/jumper-everyembodied`, PyTorch 2.8.0+cu128, MuJoCo 3.11.0. Training uses the original tasks and reference data from the upstream; the training algorithm is not modified.

## Jumping

The upstream task `jumper.jump` uses `tasks/jumper/jump/ref/high_jump_flat.npz` from the repository. The policy learning refers to the residual on the joint trajectory. Using `warp:cuda`, the 4096 environment plan is trained 1000 times. When the workstation GPU has other tasks, it actively terminates after saving the 300th checkpoint; interruption records are kept in the training log. The default upstream count is 10000, and this instance is not considered as convergence.

[ Jump Notebook](../../../../16-专题组队学习/07-Jumper螃蟹机器人专题/03-Notebook/06_跳跃_参考动作训练与评估.ipynb) contains complete commands, playable videos, and [ result JSON](../../../../16-专题组队学习/07-Jumper螃蟹机器人专题/01-学习资料/jump-result.json).[ Training logs](../../../../16-专题组队学习/07-Jumper螃蟹机器人专题/01-学习资料/jump-training.txt) · [ Evaluation logs](../../../../16-专题组队学习/07-Jumper螃蟹机器人专题/01-学习资料/jump-eval.txt) · [ Playback logs](../../../../16-专题组队学习/07-Jumper螃蟹机器人专题/01-学习资料/jump-replay.txt) · [ Joint measurements](../../../../16-专题组队学习/07-Jumper螃蟹机器人专题/01-学习资料/jump-measure.csv) · [ checkpoint](../../../../16-专题组队学习/07-Jumper螃蟹机器人专题/02-可运行代码/checkpoints/jump-model-300.pt).

Upstream `tools/checks/jump_eval.py` in a single environment, 3 done batches, with observation noise turned off. The report shows a relative reference standing height increase of 0.158–0.160 m, and a total foot-off-the-ground time of 0.320–0.325 s. The threshold for leaving the ground is that the contact force norm at each foot end does not exceed 1 N; the script samples after automatic reset and is counted per batch, and should not be considered as the success rate of multiple seeds. The video is another CPU replay: 400 Hz physics, 200 Hz control, observation noise on, running for 700 steps in about 3.5 seconds; the measurement values evaluated by the script are not synchronous measurements from this video.

## Dance

The upstream task `jumper.dance` uses the `tasks/jumper/dance/media/demo.npz` reference choreography from the repository. Training does not require music; no soundtrack is provided in the repository, so this simulation video is silent. The workstation is shared with other GPU processes and uses `warp:cuda`, 1024 environment; this batch is different from the 4096 in the upstream example. For the 200th checkpoint, a continuous run of 1000 steps at 200 Hz for physics, 50 Hz for control, and observation noise enabled is performed over about 20 seconds, and the video shows claw lifting and movement. This is just a fragment at the beginning of the approximately 235.7-second reference choreography.

[ Dance Notebook](../../../../16-专题组队学习/07-Jumper螃蟹机器人专题/03-Notebook/07_舞蹈_参考动作训练与评估.ipynb) Records training processes, evaluations, and embedded videos; [ Result JSON](../../../../16-专题组队学习/07-Jumper螃蟹机器人专题/01-学习资料/dance-result.json) · [ Playback logs](../../../../16-专题组队学习/07-Jumper螃蟹机器人专题/01-学习资料/dance-replay.txt) · [ Joint measurements](../../../../16-专题组队学习/07-Jumper螃蟹机器人专题/01-学习资料/dance-measure.csv) · [ Checkpoint used for the video](../../../../16-专题组队学习/07-Jumper螃蟹机器人专题/02-可运行代码/checkpoints/dance-model-200.pt). The joint position error in the 200th upstream training log is 1.7688 rad (joint vector L2), and the average rigid body position error is 0.0642 m; these are training batch metrics, not the playback errors mentioned above.

The training was actually completed 500 times, 12,288,000 environment steps, and the log recording took 10 minutes and 34 seconds.[Final checkpoint](../../../../16-专题组队学习/07-Jumper螃蟹机器人专题/02-可运行代码/checkpoints/dance-model-499.pt)（SHA-256 `5791a7797c4519e60b3e5b92a780c80611559b66e4f8b59c72502f984a83f0a7`) independent playback also runs for 1,000 steps and 20 seconds without terminating prematurely, with visible paw lifting and movement. In the 499th training log, the joint position error L2 is 0.3505 rad, and the average rigid body position error is 0.0123 m.
